add-cell-to-pdf-table-page-27.description: Demonstrates how to open a PDF, extract a table from page 27 using TableAbsorber, add a new cell to the table, replace the original table, and save the modified document.

replace-table-on-page-16.title: Replace Table on Specific PDF Page with Border
replace-table-on-page-16.description: Opens an existing PDF, creates a table with a default cell border, and replaces (or inserts) that table on page 16 before saving the document.

modify-table-cell-text-page-28.title: Modify Table Cell Text on a Specific PDF Page
modify-table-cell-text-page-28.description: Opens a PDF, uses TableAbsorber to extract tables from page 28, changes the text of the first cell in the first table, and saves the updated document.

replace-table-on-pdf-page-17.title: Replace Table on a Specific PDF Page
replace-table-on-pdf-page-17.description: Demonstrates how to open a PDF, locate and remove existing tables on page 17, create a new table with defined column widths, and insert it into the page using Aspose.Pdf.

remove-tables-from-pdf-page__v5.title: Remove Tables from a Specific PDF Page
remove-tables-from-pdf-page__v5.description: Shows how to use TableAbsorber to extract tables from page 29 of a PDF, copy them to an array, delete the tables from the page, and save the modified document.

insert-table-on-page-18.title: Insert Table on Page 18 of PDF
insert-table-on-page-18.description: Shows how to open a PDF, remove any existing tables, create a new table with specific column widths and borders, add a row of cells, place the table on page 18, and save the updated document.

insert-new-table-row-using-tableabsorber.title: Insert New Table Row on Page 30 Using TableAbsorber
insert-new-table-row-using-tableabsorber.description: The example opens a PDF, uses TableAbsorber to locate a table on page 30, creates a new Table with a row of cells positioned over the absorbed table, and saves the modified document.

replace-or-add-table-on-pdf-page-19.title: Replace or Add Table on PDF Page 19
replace-or-add-table-on-pdf-page-19.description: Shows how to open a PDF with Aspose.Pdf, create a table with a default border, locate an existing table on a specific page, replace it (or add a new one) and save the document.

modify-table-cell-text-on-pdf-page__v4.title: Modify Table Cell Text on a Specific PDF Page
modify-table-cell-text-on-pdf-page__v4.description: Demonstrates how to open a PDF, use TableAbsorber to extract a table from page 31, change the text of a cell, and save the updated document.

insert-table-into-pdf-page-20.title: Insert Table into Page 20 of a PDF
insert-table-into-pdf-page-20.description: Demonstrates how to open a PDF, create a table with column widths, add rows and cells, replace the content of page 20 with the table, and save the modified document using Aspose.Pdf.

replace-table-cell-content-with-tableabs.title: Replace Table Cell Content Using TableAbsorber
replace-table-cell-content-with-tableabs.description: Demonstrates how to open a PDF, absorb a table on a specific page, replace each cell's text with custom fragments, and save the modified document.

replace-or-add-table-on-pdf-page-21.title: Replace or Add Table on PDF Page 21
replace-or-add-table-on-pdf-page-21.description: Shows how to open a PDF with Aspose.Pdf, create a table with column widths and a row of cells, locate an existing table on page 21, replace it (or add if missing), and save the updated document.

add-row-to-pdf-table-using-tableabsorber.title: Add Row to PDF Table on Page 33 Using TableAbsorber
add-row-to-pdf-table-using-tableabsorber.description: Demonstrates how to open a PDF, use TableAbsorber to extract an existing table on page 33, add a new row, and save the modified document. If no table exists, it creates a new one.

insert-bordered-table-on-page-22.title: Insert Bordered Table on Page 22 of a PDF
insert-bordered-table-on-page-22.description: Demonstrates how to create a table with a default cell border, remove any existing tables on a specific page, and add the new table to page 22 of a PDF document using Aspose.Pdf.

remove-tables-from-pdf-page__v6.title: Remove Tables from a Specific PDF Page Using TableAbsorber
remove-tables-from-pdf-page__v6.description: Demonstrates how to open a PDF, extract tables from page 34 with TableAbsorber, copy them to an array, remove the tables from the page, and save the modified document.

replace-table-on-pdf-page__v3.title: Replace Table on a Specific PDF Page
replace-table-on-pdf-page__v3.description: Opens an existing PDF, creates a table with defined column widths, removes any existing tables on page 23, inserts the new table, and saves the document.

modify-table-cell-text-on-pdf-page__v5.title: Modify Table Cell Text on a Specific PDF Page
modify-table-cell-text-on-pdf-page__v5.description: Demonstrates how to open a PDF, extract tables from page 35 using TableAbsorber, change the text of the first cell, and save the updated document.

insert-table-on-specific-pdf-page__v2.title: Insert Table on a Specific PDF Page
insert-table-on-specific-pdf-page__v2.description: The example opens an existing PDF, clears the content of page 24, creates a table with defined column widths, adds a row with two text cells, and saves the modified document.

extract-table-append-text-first-cell.title: Extract Table from PDF and Append Text to First Cell
extract-table-append-text-first-cell.description: The example opens a PDF, uses TableAbsorber to locate a table on page 36, accesses the first row and cell, and appends a new TextFragment to that cell. It then saves the document (note that modifications to AbsorbedTable do not alter the original PDF).

insert-table-on-specific-pdf-page__v3.title: Insert Table on a Specific PDF Page
insert-table-on-specific-pdf-page__v3.description: Demonstrates loading a PDF, creating a table with a default border, and replacing the content of page 25 with that table using Aspose.Pdf.
